raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

This PR addresses a few consistency improvements across seqwise/tokwise:

1.  Fixed missing `None` guard for matryoshka dimensions in `TokenEmbeddingPoolerHead`.
2.  Make the `tokwise` public API consistent with `seqwise`  by exporting the analogous TokenPoolingFn and
  TokenPoolingHeadFn defined in tokwise/poolers.py
3. Added return type annotations  for `pooler_for_token_classify` , `pooler_for_embed`, and` pooler_for_classify`.

## Test Plan

`python -m pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_embedding.py -v`  [note: Qwen2-7B-Instruct-embed-base model has an existing flaky test failure in main but all others should pass]
`python -m pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_token_classification.py -v` 
`python -m pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_pooler_activations.py -v`
`python -m pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_pooler_config_init_behaviour.py -v`
`python -m pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_all_pooling_plus_chunked_prefill.py -v`
`python -m pytest tests/models/language/pooling/test_classification.py -v`

## Test Result

All should pass

nodes.body:
## Code Review

This pull request improves type safety by adding return type hints to pooling functions in the seqwise and tokwise modules. It also exports TokenPoolingFn and TokenPoolingHeadFn and introduces a null check for pooling_param.dimensions in the token-wise pooling head to prevent potential slicing errors. I have no feedback to provide as there were no review comments.
